players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Raleigh went 0-for-4 as the Mariners fell 6-7 to Kansas City at T-Mobile Park. He remains healthy and is Seattle's everyday catcher heading into May with no injury concerns.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper doubled and swiped a base in Philadelphia's 6-5 win at Miami, scoring a run. He looks healthy at first base and continues to be one of the Phillies' key contributors in a strong stretch of play.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez had the Giants' only extra-base hit — a double — but was thrown out aggressively trying to stretch it to a triple as San Francisco was shut out 3-0 by Tampa Bay. The Giants have been blanked a major-league-high seven times this season.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 1-for-4 with a run scored as the Mets edged the Angels 4-3 in Anaheim. He is healthy and playing third base daily in New York's lineup.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle went 0-for-5 as the Tigers dropped a 4-5 decision to Texas at Comerica Park. He remains the everyday shortstop in Detroit with no injury concerns.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: Crow-Armstrong went 1-for-4 with a run scored in Chicago's 6-5 win over Arizona at Wrigley Field. He is healthy and hitting in his customary spot in the Cubs lineup.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill was scratched from the Padres lineup vs. the White Sox with an ankle sprain and is considered day-to-day. San Diego expects him back in the lineup within a few days barring setbacks.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernández singled in the fourth inning but the Dodgers were routed 7-2 in St. Louis. He had a throwing error in the field but no injury concerns; LAD plans to keep him in the everyday lineup.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams earned his third save of the season with a clean inning of relief, striking out one and allowing no baserunners. His ERA stands at 7.20 on the year but recent outings have been sharp.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler bounced back with a strong outing — 6 IP, 1 ER, 8 strikeouts — earning his first win of 2026 in Philadelphia's 6-5 victory at Miami. He now has 14 Ks in 11 innings and a 2.45 ERA on the season.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans allowed four earned runs in 5⅓ innings (no decision) as the Royals won 7-6 over Seattle. His ERA climbed to 5.25 and walk-rate concerns persist with 22 BB in 37.1 IP on the year.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns was not in the rotation on May 1 as Brady Singer started a rain-delayed game for Cincinnati vs. Pittsburgh. Burns is healthy and expected back on regular turn.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi skipped a turn in the rotation as MacKenzie Gore started for Texas against Detroit on May 1. He is healthy and lined up for his next scheduled start.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan took the loss in Los Angeles's 7-2 defeat at St. Louis, allowing 4 earned runs in 4⅔ innings. Velocity concerns persist — his fastball sits 93.4 mph vs. his normal 96 — as he continues to work with coaches on mechanics.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers was not scheduled to pitch on May 1 as Walbert Ureña started for the Angels vs. the Mets. He is healthy and set to make his next start on May 2.

players.name: Giancarlo Stanton
players.summary: Stanton was officially placed on the 10-day IL (retroactive to April 25) with a left calf strain. He is expected to miss at least two more weeks and could return around mid-May.

injuries.name: Jackson Merrill
injuries.note: Ankle sprain; scratched from lineup vs. CWS on May 1

injuries.name: Giancarlo Stanton
injuries.note: Left calf strain; 10-day IL retroactive to April 25; ETA mid-May
